'''Evan Fitzgerald''' (forum handle '''PapaLorax''')<ref name="enc2008">[https://web.archive.org/web/20080803132637/http://www.swccgpc.com/modules.php?name=Encyclopedia Encyclopedia: Volunteer Information], swccgpc.com (Wayback, 3 August 2008)</ref> was a [[Players Committee]] volunteer. On 22 June 2007 the PC named him interim stand-in for Rules Advocate [[Charles Sonnenburg]], mainly to finish the Advanced Rules document.<ref name="ref2007">[https://web.archive.org/web/20070927192625/http://www.swccgpc.com/ The SWCCG Player's Committee], swccgpc.com (Wayback, 27 September 2007; PC Announcements of 22 June and 12 July 2007)</ref> In August 2008 he was the PC's Website Admin.<ref name="enc2008" />
